row.review_note: One real bird. Tighten the old publisher margin while including the visible beak, feathers and feet; preserve original coordinates in provenance.

Retain the foreground human face and person extent. Man/Woman publisher raw provenance is retained, but RF uses the fixed generic Person canonical identity; no gender inference is added. Small crowd instances remain unknown.
Umbrella canopy and pole retained as a positive target. People, dog, chairs and cups remain unknown; RF microwave is a false guess on storage drawers.
One real mobile phone; headset remains unknown. Phone box includes its cropped right/bottom extent.
